newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - LTX Corp rating raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - LTX Corp rating raised.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co said it raised its investment opinion of LTX Corp shares to outperform from outperform long-term, but did not change its recently revised earnings estimate of $0.05 per share for fiscal 1997.

-- Gruntal reiterated its view that it has low confidence in its current estimate because of the nature of the equipment market and the inability to quantify the overall effect of the company's recent restructuring.
-- LTX is well positioned to capitalize on a broad recovery in the semiconductor industry in the last few months, Gruntal said.
-- LTX makes systems to test semiconductors.
-- Its stock was unchanged Monday at 6.
